title: RIFT Asset Mesh Manifest v1
description: Per-OBJ metadata sidecar for RiftFlythrough. One manifest per exported OBJ file, recording provenance, geometry stats, and sibling/linkage data.

obj_filename.description: Filename of the OBJ file this manifest is paired with

mesh_block.description: NiMesh block index within the NIF

vertex_count.description: Number of vertices in the OBJ

face_count.description: Number of faces in the OBJ (0 = position-only, no faces)

faced.description: Whether the mesh has index-based faces

position_descriptor.description: Descriptor classification of the position stream (e.g., 'descriptor-float2-uv', 'descriptor-float3-generic')

export_mode.description: Which decode mode produced this OBJ

export_command.description: Full decode-nif-geometry command that produced this OBJ

obj_sha1.description: SHA-1 hash of the OBJ file content

obj_bytes.description: Size of the OBJ file in bytes

export_duration_sec.description: Wall-clock seconds for the decode subprocess

parent_node.description: Parent NiNode name or hash (null = root or unknown; populated in FT-4)

sibling_meshes.description: Sibling mesh NIF hashes for position-source pairing

original_path_candidates.description: Candidate original paths within the TWAD archive

bounding_box.description: Axis-aligned bounding box (optional, populated in FT-4)

rotation.description: 3x3 rotation matrix row-major [r11, r12, r13, r21, r22, r23, r31, r32, r33] (sourced from scene-graph NiNode rotation)

zone_id.description: Zone/terrain tile ID (optional, populated in FT-7)
